title: Apply supported saved report ordering before source pagination
description: Customer can save a supported ascending/descending ordering and preview/download consistent pages. Presentation already has SortFieldKey/SortDirection but providers use fixed source ordering: translate validated saved ordering to finite typed LINQ OrderBy/ThenBy before Skip/Take, never post-page sort masquerading as source sorting. First expose only persisted native orderDate/customerId for sales-order and invoiceDate/customerId for receivable fixtures, plus native identity where already selectable; use actual catalog keys. Catalog identifies sortable fields and explains unavailable ordering for calculated/related/derived monetary fields. Unknown/hidden/unselected fields and invalid directions rejected before business reads. Add immutable identity tiebreaker, preserve source fact grain, default ordering and old request behavior when sort absent. Current menu/customer scope and filters stay applied before Count/ordering/paging, total unaffected. Customer receivable reconciliation's existing ForScopedPreviewAsync source projection may accept optional finite sort and CancellationToken without changing monetary evidence calculation/default existing callers. Thread request token through touched count/page/load operations. Reject arithmetic paging overflow rather than wrap offsets. Same saved draft/pinned shared revision order and normalized sort evidence in Excel/PDF. Changing sorting resets UI page and discards stale replies. No new database index/migration or arbitrary dynamic property/SQL selection. Relevant in-memory query tests compare multiple pages and stable ties, no source/provider authorization bypass. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog and pure rules expose finite sortable persisted fields and reject invalid/unselected/unauthorized/unsupported sorting before source reads.
Both fixture adapters apply authorized finite LINQ sorting before pagination with identity tiebreaker, default compatibility, cancellation and safe offsets.
Saved/shared UI preview and generic Excel/PDF retain consistent order and query evidence; multi-page/tie/scope/default tests pass safe build/test.
